Mumbai Restaurants Face License Suspensions Over Food Safety Issues

The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the licenses of nine restaurants in Mumbai due to food safety violations. While one report specified nine establishments, another mentioned six, including notable eateries like 5 Spice, QINs, EVE, and Chaayos, citing alleged food safety concerns.
